intro: Mali has been ruled by a military government since coups in 2020 and 2021.

chapters.title: Who rules
text: General Assimi Goïta leads the country; in 2025 political parties were dissolved and he was given a renewable five-year term without election. Mali left the ECOWAS bloc and formed the Alliance of Sahel States with Burkina Faso and Niger.

chapters.title: Security
text: Armed groups linked to al-Qaeda and Islamic State attack many areas, and in 2025 a fuel blockade hit Bamako.
